Name: Heir - Hero - Spirit - Rupnan's Collection
Author: Rupnan
Description:
[quote][center][size=4]Rupnan’s NPC Collection: Unified Edition[/size][/center]
[/quote]This project unifies my three main characters Aurelian, Kaelen, and Junimi into a single, cohesive package. Moving forward, all story expansions, new quests, and technical fixes will be made exclusively here.

Note on standalone mods:
Individual versions of Aurelian, Kaelen, and Junimi will no longer be updated. Please switch to this unified collection for the latest content.

[quote][center][color=#ffffff][size=4]CONTENT[/size][/color][/center]
[/quote]*Characters (NPCs)
 Aurelian: Mayor Lewis's grandson and tech genius.
 Kaelen: Guild Captain and military strategist.
 Junimi: Spirit of the forest.
 Litch: Social Junimo in charge of his own shop.
 5 Antisocial Junimos: New characters with unique personalities.
 1 Main Villain: A new antagonist for the story.

 *Combat and Enemies
 2 New Monsters: Unique enemies to eradicate.
 2 Monster Loot Drops: New items dropped by enemies.
 1 New Sword: Custom weapon for combat.
 1 Combat Boots: Footwear with defense stats.
 1 Trinket: Functional Harvesting Junimo.

 *Farming and Foraging
 10 New Crops: Added plants for the seasons.
 1 Fruit Tree: A new variety for your orchard.
 1 Forage Item: A new wild collectible.

 *Machines and Items
 3 New Machines: New processing systems.
 10 New Items: Including materials and consumables.
 5 Cooking Recipes: New dishes with special effects.


[quote][center][size=4]Aurelian: The Urban Heir[/size][/center]
[/quote]Mayor Lewis’s grandson has arrived from Zuzu City. At 16 years old and with a clear tech addiction, Aurelian brings a cynical perspective that contrasts with the quiet rural life of Pelican Town.

* Dynamic Routines: His schedule changes drastically with the seasons. In winter, you’ll find him retreating into his gadgets, while during warmer months, he attempts to fulfill his "family duties" outdoors.

* Immersive Dialogue: Features over 2900+ lines of dialogue that react to the weather, festivals, and other neighbors like Abigail, Sam, and Sebastian.

[quote][center][size=4]Kaelen: The Guild’s Captain[/size][/center]
[/quote]A 27-year-old veteran and military strategist deployed from Castle Village to secure the mines. Kaelen is a deep character with a mature perspective on conflict and duty.

* Marriage Candidate: Kaelen is a fully functional bachelor. He includes a custom spouse room, unique daily farm behaviors, and exclusive marriage dialogue.

* Rank System: As you progress through the mines and earn his trust, he will grant you official military titles and elite rewards, such as his personal blade, the Cyan Spatha.

* Lore Integration: Features special scripted events with Kent (regarding the front lines), Abigail (mentorship), and Marlon.

[quote][center][size=4]Junimi: The Forest Spirit[/size][/center]
[/quote]A mystical entity inhabiting a hollow log in the forest. Junimi is more than just an NPC she is an extension of the valley's ancient magic.

* Farming and Cooking Mechanics: Introduces over 8 new crops and the Junimo Kitchen a unique processing machine used to prepare special stews with powerful buffs for combat and mining.

* Barter Shop: Interact with Litchi and the "Antisocial" Junimos. Forget gold here you will need to forage Carmine Petals to trade for unique seeds and rare items.

* Evolving Schedules: Her behavior changes based on the restoration of the Community Center, as she gradually integrates into the local community.

[quote][center][size=4]SONIC REFINER PROCESSING GUIDE[/size][/center]
[/quote][center][/center]
[center]1. [color=#ffffff][size=4]GLASS AND QUARTZ[/size] [/color][/center]
[center]Input: Broken Glasses, Broken CD, Frozen Tear, Joja Cola, or Clam.[/center]
[center]Output: Refined Quartz.[/center]
[center][/center]
[center]2. [color=#ffffff][size=4]TEXTILES AND PAPER[/size][/color] [/center]
[center]Input: Soggy Newspaper or Dwarf Scrolls (I, II, III, or IV).[/center]
[center]Output: Cloth.[/center]
[center][/center]
[center]3. [color=#ffffff][size=4]CLAY AND GEODE[/size][/color][/center]
[center]Input: Geode (Normal, Frozen, Magma, or Omni), Nautilus Shell, Coral, Rainbow Shell, or Earth Crystal.[/center]
[center]Output: 1 to 3 Clay.[/center]
[center][/center]
[center]4. [color=#ffffff][size=4]SAP[/size][/color] [/center]
[center]Input: 20 Sap.[/center]
[center]Output: Pine Tar (70%) or Oak Resin (30%).[/center]
[center][/center]
[center]5. [color=#ffffff][size=4]GEMS AND MINERALS[/size] [/color][/center]
[center]Input: Emerald, Aquamarine, Ruby, Amethyst, Topaz, Jade, Diamond, Quartz, Fire Quartz, or Nightstone.[/center]
[center]Output: Mineral Flask [/center]
[center][/center]
[center]6. [color=#ffffff][size=4]BOTANICAL[/size] [size=4]ESSENCES[/size][/color][/center]
[center]Input: Daffodil, Poppy, Sweet Pea, Crocus, Sunflower, Tulip, Summer Spangle, Fairy Rose, Blue Jazz, or Blood Bloom.[/center]
[center]Output: Botanical Dropper.[/center]
[center][/center]
